Hi Tallgrass Labs team,

Welcome to the Claude Partner Network. Your firm is now registered at the Registered level, and we're glad to have you.

To move up to Select, you'll need to meet the items below. Our next tier review date is January 1, 2027.

1. Certified practitioners: You need 10 active certified people. Right now 6 of your certified team members have Claude activity in the last 90 days. To close the gap, have 4 more certified people use Claude in their work, or certify additional team members and have them start using Claude. Activity counts only when it's on your firm's own email domain.

Once you have 10 active certified practitioners, reply to this email and we'll re-check your application for Select.

Thanks for your partnership,
Partner Desk

steps.text:
APP-1021 (Tallgrass Labs) is approved at Registered, and a welcome draft is waiting in the outbox for a human to send.

**Verified against the systems of record:**

| Check | Claimed | Verified |
|---|---|---|
| Active certified practitioners | 12 | 6 |
| Joint customers | 3 | 3 (all North America, production) |
| Public stories | 1 | 1 (200, public, names firm and Claude) |
| Direct enterprise account conflict | — | None |
| Existing partner account or other applications on domain | — | None |
| Compliance screening | — | Clear |

The other 6 certified people hold current certs but haven't used Claude in 90 days, so they don't count toward Select. The bench is not a mismatch under the 2× rule, since all 12 records exist, but the firm's 12 claim overstates its active bench. I flagged `inactive_practitioners`.

**Why Registered and not Select:** Select needs 10 active certified practitioners, and the firm has 6. Joint customers and the public story would meet Select on their own. The firm is 4 practitioners short.

**Draft welcome:** It lists the gap (4 more active certified practitioners, with the fix) and the next promotion date, January 1, 2027.

steps.text:
APP-1022 (Wren & Oak) is routed to human review, not approved.

- **Route:** Human review, because Redwood Bank is attributed to another partner in Claude account data.
- **Requested tier:** Select. The verified numbers support Registered, not Select.
- **Joint customers:** claimed 2, verified 1. Westbrook Bank verifies; Redwood Bank is attributed to another partner.
- **Certified bench:** claimed 10, verified 10 active. No expired certs, inactive holders, or other-domain matches.
- **Public story:** Falcon Crest Media returns 200, is public, and names both the firm and Claude. It counts toward the minimum of one.
- **Clean checks:** screening is clear, there are no direct enterprise account conflicts, no existing partner account on the domain, and no duplicate submissions.

Flag recorded: `attribution_conflict`. Recommended tier: Registered. No email was drafted, since human-review cases don't get one. A reviewer needs to resolve the Redwood Bank attribution. If it clears, the applicant still falls short of Select on joint customers and would be placed at Registered.
